deadline.value: Doctoral applications for fall entry should reach admissions by February 15; the catalog says applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: The catalog names no GRE Subject test for mathematics.

supervisor.value: Each doctoral student gets an academic advisor after admission; the catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: All students pursuing a doctoral degree will have an academic advisor (and co-advisor, if applicable) who must be a member of the Missouri S&T graduate faculty.

funding.value: The catalog says fellowships and assistantships are available to qualified applicants, without a funding rate.

entry_route.value: The M.S. is recommended but not required before the PhD, and students can enter without one.
entry_route.quote: The M.S. is recommended, but not required, as a prerequisite for the Ph.D.

notes: The PhD can be pursued with a statistics emphasis, so statistics is listed as also_fields. Department PhD pages on the mst.edu subdomains could not be reached (TLS verification failure through the proxy); this record uses the graduate catalog only.
